style_prefix: Richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink contours with restrained watercolor, worn carved stone, tarnished brass, dark slate, fine gold and copper rune channels, warm amber workshop lamps, cool blue-white mana light, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical magical machinery, intimate trade-town scale, unlettered surfaces.

prompts.prompt: Compact rune repair shop carved beneath a broad stone rail stair: arched public counter, long rear workbench, copper hood, blue mana lamp, sand test cradle, material balance, hanging stone test slips; young brown-skinned dwarf apprentice lifts the shutter while an older silver-bearded dwarf Master lights the bench.

Close rune-shop counter with dozens of thumb-length pale stone and dark slate witness slips hanging from wires, each bearing one gold or copper junction, hooked null, and blank job edge; chalk-cuffed dwarf apprentice turns the rack while morning customers queue with kettles and lamps.

Rust-bearded dwarf rail conductor in slate-blue coat sets a hooded inspection lamp and old pale colour slip on a stone counter; the lamp has a newer dark-slate rune face, gold-and-copper channels, leather handle, and brass service ring; apprentice studies the mismatch.

Object close-up under white bench light: dwarf apprentice aligns pale thumb-length witness slip against dark-slate lamp face; geometric runes match while the second lamp channel is visibly deeper; gold and copper fills, job marks, and brass service ring sharp in focus.

Dark-slate rail lamp secured in a brass-rimmed cradle of pale sand under a copper hood; leather handle extends toward the counter; rail conductor points with a heavy glove to warmth below the second mixed-metal turn while dwarf apprentice marks it in chalk.

Brass shop balance holds a costly coil of fine gold wire beside a dark-slate rail lamp and pale returned slip; young dwarf apprentice names the weight while rust-bearded conductor removes his cap and studies the financially offensive repair.

Young dwarf apprentice hangs a pale rune-cut witness slip bright side outward in an arched market counter; gold and copper seams catch amber light; conductor smiles, older silver-bearded Master watches severely, and two customers pause with ordinary repair objects.

Older silver-bearded dwarf Master turns a dark-slate lamp plate over to reveal a tiny supplier mark; young apprentice holds the pale old witness beside it; rust-bearded rail conductor watches across the counter amid hanging slips, sand cradle, balance, and moving train-light shadows.

Pivotal close-up of fresh dark-slate test slip clipped beneath copper hood: short gold-and-copper junction, hooked null, scratched job edge, crystal shaving, and brown heat stain opening under the second turn and stopping at the null; chalky dwarf hands steady the clip.

Old pale-stone witness slip glows evenly in a brass mana clip and remains polished and cool; current dark-slate lamp waits separately in sand cradle; young dwarf apprentice watches uncertainly while older Master keeps one finger on its service ring.

Top-down rune-shop bench: one continuous fine gold wire follows a lamp graph drawn on waxed slate from input to hooked null; original gold-and-copper dark lamp face and weighted gold coil lie beside it; apprentice presses wire with blunt probe while conductor watches.

Brass magnifier spans pale old witness and dark replacement slate, revealing open grains around the deeper second channel; older silver-bearded dwarf Master offers a blunt probe while chalk-cuffed apprentice examines the porous edge under crossing amber and blue-white light.

Whole rune-shop choice surface: arched counter divides rust-bearded rail conductor from young apprentice and older Master; old pale slip, current dark lamp, fresh dark witness, sand cradle, measured gold, job wire, workshop punch, hanging slip rack, and rail-bell light all visible.

Young dwarf apprentice offers a cool shining rail lamp across the stone counter; a fresh dark-slate colour slip with job mark, hooked null, and faint brown test stain hangs from its brass service ring; conductor receives both under moving rail lights.

Rail lamp rebuilt with one plain continuous gold channel on dark slate, matching gold witness on service ring, removed copper in return tray, and heavy bill beside brass balance; conductor holds lamp while apprentice points to cost and older Master raises lidded tea.

Dark-slate lamp remains open in sand cradle while workshop punch hangs unused; old pale slip and current face sit side by side; young apprentice and older Master face rust-bearded conductor as he prepares an awkward short-handled depot spare.

Pale accepted slip and dark current-job slip lie side by side between rail lamp, measured gold coil, and bell clock at a stone counter; apprentice points to material evidence while conductor holds a short depot spare and chooses between time and repair.
